preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 50 and 1 <= m <= 50 and n * m >= 2 and 1 <= k <= 4 for n, m, k in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[:1]])
preconditions.description: Input dimensions n, m, and k are within bounds (1 ≤ n, m ≤ 50, n·m ≥ 2, 1 ≤ k ≤ 4).

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) == n + 1 and all(len(line) == m for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Input has exactly n lines of m characters each, following the first line with n, m, k.
The map contains exactly one 'S' (start) and one 'T' (target).

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzST' for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for c in line)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the map is a lowercase Latin letter, 'S', or 'T'.

postconditions.expression: (stdout == '' or stdout == '\n') and any(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdout.strip()) for _ in range(2))
postconditions.description: If a valid path exists where the sequence of plot types (excluding 'S' and 'T') has at most k distinct types, stdout is the lexicographically smallest shortest path (empty or newline if no types).

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' and not any(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdout.strip()) for _ in range(2))
postconditions.description: If no valid path exists, stdout is '-1'.

postconditions.expression: len(set(stdout.strip())) <= k if stdout != '-1' and stdout.strip() else True
postconditions.description: The output path (if not '-1') contains at most k distinct plot types (excluding 'S' and 'T').

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.strip() <= other_path for other_path in possible_paths) if stdout != '-1' and stdout.strip() else True
postconditions.description: The output path (if not '-1') is lexicographically minimal among all shortest valid paths, where possible_paths is the set of all valid shortest paths with ≤ k distinct types.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.strip()) == min(len(path) for path in possible_paths) if stdout != '-1' and stdout.strip() else True
postconditions.description: The output path (if not '-1') is the shortest valid path (minimizing time, i.e., length).
